method: Built-in image_gen through Codex gpt-6-astra at high effort
scope: New spell effects only; existing creature, weapon and interface images unchanged.
prompt: Four images on #FF00FF matched to spells-fresco-v12.png and hazards-fresco-v33.png: a burning ring seen from above, a pale ritual circle, a crescent cut of ash and ember, a tiling ray of starlight.
processing: Magenta keyed to alpha, each image resized to one 1024 cell of a 2 by 2 atlas; the ray seam crossfaded over 24 pixels.
